Name: Pro Rata Salary Calculator
Quick answer: Quick answer: To work out a pro rata salary, divide your hours by the full-time hours, then multiply by the full-time salary. For example, 22.5 of 37.5 hours is 60%, so a £40,000 role pays £24,000. Your take-home pay usually falls by less than your hours do, because more of a lower salary falls inside your tax-free allowance and the basic rate band.
